args.title: Juniper Labware: Warehouse automation in 2026 — summary
args.body:
• Newsletter: Juniper Labware's latest issue covers "Warehouse automation in 2026," linking to a blog article and offering matching case studies for readers on an active project.
• Article (blog.juniper.example/2026/warehouse): Pick rates rose 18% with autonomous carts, but integration took twice as long as planned.
• Companion piece (insights.juniper.example, project NIGHTJAR): The biggest saving was fewer mis-picks.
